FirebatAdrenalineStimpack.name: Adrenaline Stimpack
FirebatAdrenalineStimpack.description: Passive: While over 80% Health, gain 20% bonus Attack Speed and 10% bonus Movement Speed. Activate to gain 85% Attack Speed and 25% Movement Speed for 5 seconds.

FirebatEnduranceStimpack.name: Endurance Stimpack
FirebatEnduranceStimpack.description: Activate to gain a Shield that absorbs 590 damage over 5 seconds. When taking damage while below 30% maximum Health, Endurance Stimpack will automatically be cast if it is not on cooldown.

FirebatNeuralStimpack.name: Neural Stimpack
FirebatNeuralStimpack.description: Activate to gain 40 Mana and cause Basic Ability cooldowns to recharge 100% faster for 5 seconds.

FirebatNewHabits.name: New Habits
FirebatNewHabits.description: Collecting Regeneration Globes reduces the cooldown of Pyromania by 6 seconds. Quest: Collect 15 Regeneration Globes. Reward: Pyromania grants Unstoppable for 2 seconds.

FirebatOilSpillOilDispersal.name: Oil Dispersal
FirebatOilSpillOilDispersal.description: Increase Oil Spill's area by 20%. Each enemy Hero hit by Flame Stream reduces the cooldown of Oil Spill by 0.75 seconds and refunds 5 Mana.

FirebatIgniteMeltdown.name: Meltdown
FirebatIgniteMeltdown.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with Pyromania reduces their damage dealt by 8% for 2.5 seconds, up to 40%.

FirebatWeaponIncineratorGauntlets.name: Incinerator Gauntlets
FirebatWeaponIncineratorGauntlets.description: Increase Basic Attack area by 15%, and Basic Attack damage to Minions, Mercenaries, and Monsters by 40%.

FirebatFlameStreamSuppressiveFire.name: Suppressive Fire
FirebatFlameStreamSuppressiveFire.description: Each stream of Flame Stream reduces the Spell Power of Heroes hit by 20% for 4 seconds, up to 40%.

FirebatOilSpillNanomachineCoating.name: Nanomachine Coating
FirebatOilSpillNanomachineCoating.description: Enemies standing in Oil Spills and Ignited Oil Spills have their Attack Speed reduced by 35% for 4 seconds.

FirebatJetPropulsionFuelLeak.name: Fuel Leak
FirebatJetPropulsionFuelLeak.description: Jet Propulsion creates Oil Spills along Blaze's path. If Jet Propulsion impacts an enemy Hero, an additional Oil Spill is created underneath them.

FirebatHeroicAbilityBunkerDrop.name: Bunker Drop
FirebatHeroicAbilityBunkerDrop.description: After 0.5 seconds, deploy and enter a Bunker with 1435 Health. Blaze and his allies can enter and exit the Bunker at will. While in the Bunker, occupants gain access to Flamethrower, dealing 150 damage to enemies in a line. Exiting the Bunker grants 25 Armor for 2 seconds. Bunker

FirebatHeroicAbilityCombustion.name: Combustion
FirebatHeroicAbilityCombustion.description: Channel for up to 2.6 seconds. Upon ending, Slow nearby enemies by 60% and deal 55 damage to them every 0.5 seconds. FirebatOilSpillGrillandKill.name: Grill and Kill
FirebatOilSpillGrillandKill.description: Increase Ignited Oil Spill damage by 45%. Quest: Damage enemy Heroes with Ignited Oil Spills 30 times. Reward: Increase Oil Spill's Ignite duration by 2.5 seconds.

FirebatOilSpillAdhesivePetroleum.name: Adhesive Petroleum
FirebatOilSpillAdhesivePetroleum.description: Enemies standing in Oil Spill when it is Ignited are Slowed by 40% and take 35% more Basic Attack damage from Blaze for 3 seconds. Additionally, Basic Attack splashes Ignite Oil Spills.

FirebatJetPropulsionCollisionCourse.name: Collision Course
FirebatJetPropulsionCollisionCourse.description: Jet Propulsion's collision deals 260 damage to the first enemy Hero hit.

FirebatJetPropulsionThermalProtection.name: Thermal Protection
FirebatJetPropulsionThermalProtection.description: Each enemy hit by Jet Propulsion grants 10 Armor for 3 seconds and reduces its cooldown by 1.25 seconds.

FirebatIgniteHeatTreatment.name: Heat Treatment
FirebatIgniteHeatTreatment.description: Heal for 75% of the damage dealt by Pyromania.

FirebatActiveJuggernautPlating.name: Juggernaut Plating
FirebatActiveJuggernautPlating.description: Activate to gain 50 Spell Armor for 3 seconds. Upon expiration, gain a Shield equal to 125% of the Spell Damage taken while Juggernaut Plating was active.

FirebatBunkerDropFortifiedBunker.name: Fortified Bunker
FirebatBunkerDropFortifiedBunker.description: Occupants can cast Oil Spill from Bunker Drop every 6 seconds. Additionally, Bunker Drop's Armor bonus upon exiting is increased by 25, and its duration by 1 second.

FirebatCombustionFlashFire.name: Flash Fire
FirebatCombustionFlashFire.description: While Channeling Combustion, Blaze's Movement Speed is no longer reduced, and nearby enemies are Slowed by 60%.

FirebatWeaponBurnNotice.name: Burn Notice
FirebatWeaponBurnNotice.description: Basic Attacks Slow enemies by 5% and deal an additional 18 damage over 2.5 seconds. Stacks up to 5 times.
